assumptions: Price not given; assumed $60 for a 'unknown' product.
Gross margin not given; assumed 45% (typical for pet).
subscription: assumed 4.0 orders per customer over ~6 months.
Target CPA = 70% of max affordable CAC ($60 x 45% margin x 4.0 orders = $108.00).

pricing.rationale: Acquisition goal with no conversion history: pay per click. Max CPC = target CPA $75.60 x click-to-purchase rate (1.5%-5.0%). Clicks are observable without trusting a pixel, so both sides can verify billing.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded; until then Disco can't predict conversion rate for this brand.

budget.pacing: even daily pacing; pause a host if CPA > 2.0x target after 150 clicks

allocations.rationale: score 0.49 -> fit x1.40 on CTR/CVR; max bid $3.18 (break-even at target CPA), start at 70% and raise only if under-delivering; host sells a competing product, so it may decline (capacity discounted)
